## Problem

Describe the problem and link a related issue if there is one.

## Change

Explain the smallest useful change and any compatibility implications.

## Verification

List the commands you actually ran and their results. State which checks were
unavailable instead of marking them as passed.

## Risks and Recovery

Describe remaining risks and rollback steps when deployment or data is affected.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Behaviour changes have appropriate tests.
- [ ] Relevant local validation and build checks pass, or limitations are stated.
- [ ] Documentation matches changed usage or operational behaviour.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated binaries, or state files are included.
- [ ] Source code, scripts, and workflows remain comment-free.
- [ ] Security checks and branch protection have not been weakened or bypassed.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the MIT License.
